config_version_history.status: SUPERSEDED - declared OPEN after phase4_heldout run found a real defect (docs/v2/PHASE4_STATUS.md): ChEMBLTool.resolve_compound_name()'s fuzzy-match tier had no similarity threshold, so a fabricated compound name ('Zorblatinix-9X') returned a confident, real-but-unrelated ChEMBL ID (CHEMBL5875133) instead of failing safely.

config_version_history.note: Fix for the config_version 1 defect: tools/chembl_tool.py's resolve_compound_name() now gates its fuzzy tier with a difflib.SequenceMatcher-based similarity check (FUZZY_MATCH_MIN_SIMILARITY=0.6) against the top ChEMBL candidate's pref_name and synonyms, chosen after live-verifying ChEMBL's own native ES score is an uncalibrated corpus-wide Lucene score unusable as a fixed threshold (fabricated name scored higher than a genuine typo in a direct comparison). Below threshold, returns match_type='no_match'/chembl_id=None instead of a misleading id. Regression-verified against dev+validation (all 13 previously-fixed real-compound cases unaffected, ChEMBL Recall@10 still 1.0) and confirmed via a fresh, never-before-used 10-case held-out supplement (artifacts/v2/phase4_chembl_fuzzy_threshold_supplement.json): 4/4 fabricated names correctly rejected, 3/3 genuine near-miss typos still resolve, 2/2 synonym-tier sanity checks unaffected, zero misleading IDs returned. Full details: docs/v2/CHEMBL_FUZZY_MATCH_THRESHOLD_FIX.md, docs/v2/PHASE4_CHEMBL_FUZZY_THRESHOLD_SUPPLEMENT_RESULTS.md. Original phase4_heldout (12 cases) and its results were NOT re-run or touched by this fix.

selection_priority_applied: docs/v2/PHASE4_GATE_PLAN.md Section 4: correctness/recall > no systematic source failure > ranking quality > multi-source coverage > latency > cost/complexity

pubmed.selected_architecture: local RAG hybrid pipeline (retrieval/retriever.py: FAISS dense + BM25 sparse -> RRF fusion k=60 -> cross-encoder rerank)
pubmed.corpus_version: data/corpus/abstracts.jsonl, 9000 abstracts (subsampled from 13115-abstract raw fetch, seed=42) - known reproducibility gap documented in artifacts/v2/phase4_retrieval_inventory.json integrity_issues_found, NOT fixed in Phase 4 (out of scope: corpus is stable/live-in-use, not corrupted; reproducibility script gap is a build-tooling issue, not a retrieval-quality defect)

rejected_alternatives.fixed_live_api_raw_query: Recall@10 0.045 (n=22) - rejected, no better than broken baseline
rejected_alternatives.fixed_live_api_plus_compiler: Recall@10 0.136, MRR 0.059 (n=22) - rejected, RAG wins by 5.7x recall and 10x+ MRR
rejected_alternatives.rag_plus_live_fusion: not built - checked and confirmed zero unique recall contribution from live path (all 3 of its hits already hit by RAG), so fusion would add noise/duplication risk with no demonstrated benefit

pubmed.query_compiler_built_but_not_selected: retrieval/pubmed_query_compiler.py - real, tested, deterministic compiler exists for any future caller needing live-PubMed search, but is not part of the frozen primary retrieval path

clinical_trials.selected_architecture: live ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API, structured filters (condition/intervention/status/phase), phase filtering via AREA[Phase]<value> query.term (fixed from invalid filter.phase parameter)
clinical_trials.ranking: no additional ranking layer added beyond the API's own default ordering - structured filtering already narrows results effectively (filter-correctness 0.850) and no measurement showed post-filter ranking as a bottleneck; simplest architecture that clears gates
clinical_trials.local_index: none - live-API-only, confirmed correct architecture per audit (no evidence a local trials index would help; trial data changes frequently, live is authoritative)

chembl.selected_architecture: live ChEMBL web services API, 4 operations: search_by_target, search_by_indication, get_drug_info, resolve_compound_name (new)
chembl.fuzzy_match_similarity_gate: difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio, threshold 0.6, against top candidate's pref_name + synonyms; below threshold returns no_match/chembl_id=None instead of a misleading fuzzy id (config v2 fix, see config_version_history)
chembl.no_fabricated_ids: structurally guaranteed - resolve_compound_name never returns a chembl_id not present in a real upstream API response
chembl.no_misleading_low_confidence_ids: guaranteed as of config v2 - the fuzzy tier rejects low-similarity matches as no_match rather than presenting a real-but-unrelated id with false confidence
chembl.known_accepted_limitation: search_by_target first-hit heuristic on ambiguous target names (3/21 cases) - see artifacts/v2/phase4_failure_analysis.json

multi_source.fusion_method: none required at the ranking-score level (per contract Section 5, source-local scores are not fused into one universal score) - per-source RetrievalCandidate lists returned, each tagged with source/retrieval_method/source_rank; downstream consumer (agent/nodes.py) already keeps per-tool result lists distinct, which is the correct behavior given source-local score incomparability
multi_source.quotas: none imposed - all sources selected by Phase-3 orchestration are executed and their results all retained, no source is capped/starved by a Phase-4 quota policy
multi_source.coverage_dev_validation: 0.571 (4/7) measured before final architecture integration; 3 remaining misses attributed to (a) PubMed leg scored against the non-selected live-API path rather than RAG [expected to improve once integration uses the frozen RAG architecture] and (b) one ClinicalTrials ranking miss [accepted limitation]

next_step: Run phase4_heldout split (12 cases) exactly once against this frozen configuration.
